scope: native contract and logical ownership; no authoritative fencing, SunFS mount, concurrent SMP or physical durability qualification
runner_seed_label: 0x5b1001 is a fixed scenario label, not a PRNG input
fault_seed: none: deterministic injected tuples and explicit boundary cases
retirement: exact active completed owner once; request ownership retires, PMM allocations remain kernel lifetime
timeout_policy: active ID retained; no DMA data copy or descriptors republished after latch
removal_shutdown: Owner model quarantine only; no production hot-unplug/shutdown owner protocol implemented
resources: four queue frames + one bounce frame retained by kernel PMM allocation policy; unsafe init precondition forbids reinitializing live/quarantined attachment
